scripts.run-pipeline: node -e "(async () => { const { tasks } = require('@trigger.dev/sdk/v3'); const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs'); const trialId = readFileSync('/logs/trial_id', 'utf8').trim(); const handle = await tasks.trigger(`resilient-pipeline-${trialId}`, { input: 'initial data' }); console.log(`Run ID: ${handle.id}`); })().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });"
scripts.complete-waitpoint: node -e "(async () => { const { wait } = require('@trigger.dev/sdk/v3'); const { readFileSync } = require('node:fs'); const token = readFileSync('/home/user/resilient-pipeline/waitpoint_token.txt', 'utf8').trim(); await wait.completeToken(token, { correctedInput: 'fixed data' }); console.log('Waitpoint completed'); })().catch((error) => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });"
